name: Potassium bromate
restriction: Banned as a flour treatment agent in food in India.
reference: FSSAI notification, 2016 (withdrawal of use in bread & bakery)

name: Potassium iodate
restriction: Banned for use in bread/bakery products (flour treatment) in India.

name: Cyclamate (artificial sweetener)
restriction: Not a permitted artificial sweetener under FSSAI standards.
reference: FSS (Food Products Standards & Food Additives) Regulations, 2011

name: Rhodamine B
restriction: Non-permitted synthetic colour — common adulterant, not allowed in food.
reference: FSS (Food Products Standards & Food Additives) Regulations, 2011

name: Metanil yellow
restriction: Non-permitted synthetic colour, not allowed in food.
reference: FSS (Food Products Standards & Food Additives) Regulations, 2011

name: Auramine
restriction: Non-permitted synthetic colour, not allowed in food.
reference: FSS (Food Products Standards & Food Additives) Regulations, 2011

name: Sudan dyes
restriction: Non-permitted industrial dyes, not allowed in food.

name: Argemone (prickly poppy) oil
restriction: Adulterant in edible oils — consumption causes epidemic dropsy; not permitted.

name: Silver leaf (vark / chandi varak)
restriction: Permitted only as food-grade silver foil conforming to IS 6983:2008; non-food-grade foil is prohibited.

name: Monosodium glutamate in infant food
restriction: MSG is permitted in adult foods only in limited use; not permitted in infant food products.
reference: FSS (Food Products Standards & Food Additives) Regulations, 2011
